facts.fact: The National Financial Ombud South Africa Banking Division resolved disputes in 2025 and reports that mobile banking and internet banking fraud were the highest complaint generators, 39% of all cases received.
facts.system: National Financial Ombud South Africa Banking Division

note: R60 million returned is an all-banking redress total, not an enforcement figure for digital services; the 39% is a share of cases, not a sanction or complaint count under digital rules.
